title: Signed tensor-dual evaluation commutes with differentials
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $P,Q$ any cochain complexes on the bottom-topology one-object ringed site [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map], $D=\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(P,A[0])$ the explicit dual [lem-pc-perfect-ring-dual-term-flat], $T=\operatorname{Tot}(D\otimes Q)$ the shared tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and $H=\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(P,Q)$ the shared Hom [def-pur-hom-complex]. Suppose a family of morphisms $f_n:T^n\to H^n$ satisfies the normalization specified in [lem-pc-perfect-ring-hom-tensor-degrees]: every $(r,s)$ summand is zero in coordinates $p\ne-r$ and sends $\lambda\otimes y$ to $x\mapsto(-1)^{rs}\lambda(x)y$ in coordinate $-r$, with the stated sheafification and degree transports. Then for all adjacent degrees $n,m$, $f_n d_H^{n,m}=d_T^{n,m}f_m$. No bound on either complex, projectivity, finiteness or invertibility of the $f_n$ is assumed.

proof.text: Restrict the desired identity to every tensor coproduct summand and every Hom product projection using their universal properties. Expand the Hom differential into postcomposition minus the signed precomposition term, and expand the tensor differential into its first and second summand maps.

Use the separate postcomposition and precomposition component identities for a=f_n and b=f_(n+1). Substitute them into the expansions; additivity, associativity and the abelian-group identity X-Y=(-Y)+X combine the terms.

theorem perfectRingHom_tensorDual_degree_comm {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (P Q : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A)
    ∀ (f : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor (perfectRingDual P) Q (curriedTensor _)).X n ⟶
        (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q).X n),
      (∀ n : ℤ, PerfectRingHomTensorDegreeCondition P Q n (f n)) →
      ∀ n m : ℤ, (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel n m →
        f n ≫ (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q).d n m =
          (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor (perfectRingDual P) Q (curriedTensor _)).d n m ≫
            f m
